pages.text: Black gem between diamond and netherite. Used for tools, armor, the $(item)Onyx Lantern$() and the $(item)Infernal Heart$(). Accepted by beacons.
9 Onyx Shards (from Onyx Clusters) also make a gem.
Glowing crystals of the Petrified Onyx Forest. Mine them for $(item)Onyx Shards$() (Silk Touch keeps the cluster).
